method: Each handler was read from its first line to the first write/subprocess/thread/network call or return. No handler was executed. risk=safe: no write and no external call. risk=validate: an empty JSON body {} is provably rejected with a 4xx before any side effect AND the success path neither destroys state nor starts/stops/deletes/approves/trains/installs/restarts pipeline work. risk=exclude: everything else; where such a route still has a provable empty-body 4xx it is recorded in empty_body_status for reference only.
